Local civic engagement is spearheaded by a dedicated Neighbourhood Board made up of local ward councillors, residents, and representatives from public services and community organisations. The area benefits from active local groups, including the Allestree Carnival community organisation and the Friends of Allestree Park group.

NHS general practice medical services in Allestree are provided from two main sites: Park Lane Surgery and Park Farm Medical Centre.
